['Transgourmet Central and Eastern Europ.company_description: Transgourmet Central and Eastern Europe GmbH is a food distribution company operating in Central and Eastern Europe. It offers a wide range of food products and has a significant presence in the region.

['Stihl Holding AG & Co. KG '].company_description: Stihl is a German manufacturer of chainsaws and other handheld power equipment including trimmers and blowers. Their headquarters are in Waiblingen, Baden-Württemberg, near Stuttgart, Germany. Stihl was founded in 1926 by Andreas Stihl and is known for being the world's best-selling brand of chain saws and the only chain saw manufacturer to make its own saw chains and guide bars. Stihl also operates the Stihl Timbersports Series.
